title: Export the scoped dynamic follow-up due page to PDF
description: A salesperson downloads the selected bounded follow-up reminder page as a Chinese PDF from the visual designer. Reuse current-user authorized preview for every download, checking the follow-up-due menu and SalespersonDataScopeService again; revoked access yields no file. Preserve selected fields, due-date evidence, current-page and read-only boundary text. Reuse PDFsharp and shared SimHei resolver; split wide columns and long rows rather than clipping; missing font fails clearly. Existing HTTP operation logging audits export. Development only: no schema or migration changes, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused PDF/UI tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded PDF endpoint reruns authorized preview and returns only selected current-page rows; invalid or revoked requests return no PDF.
PDF preserves selected columns, Chinese labels, due evidence, boundary and empty-page meaning, paginates wide and long content, and fails explicitly without SimHei.
Designer downloads PDF with current filters and page and shows denied/network errors; focused PDF/UI tests and safe Release build/test pass.
